title: Commit-safe Role Edits: Preview Diff & Member Simulator
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design and prototype a ‘commit-safe’ role editing experience inside Console that lets admins preview the effective permission diff and simulate member-level impact before applying changes. This work covers the role editor surface, the inline member assignment wizard, and a temporal/expiry UI for time-limited grants. The goal is to reduce accidental privilege escalation, speed up safe role updates, and provide clear links to the audit log and SSO attribute context. Deliverables: high-fidelity mocks, an interactive prototype, acceptance criteria, and a handoff-ready spec for engineering and security review.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can open a role edit modal and see a clear, human-readable diff between current and proposed permissions (added / removed / modified).
A member simulator lets admins select a user or group to preview that member's effective permissions after the proposed change, including SSO-mapped attributes (e.g., department, org_unit).
Temporal assignment UI supports setting an expiry and shows a visual timeline and calendar entry. Expiring grants are annotated in the preview and included in the audit metadata.
All proposed changes show an estimated customer-impact tag (none|low|medium|high) computed from labels and dependencies. The tag is editable by a PM before commit.
The commit flow requires an explicit confirmation step that surfaces: summary diff, impacted members count, and a link to the audit log entry that will be created.
Design spec includes annotated CSS tokens, responsive behavior for Console (desktop primary, compact mobile/side panel), and accessibility considerations (keyboard nav, screen reader labels).
Engineering handoff contains Figma frames, redlines, and a prototype with interaction notes; security review sign-off recorded in Confluence.
tasks: Run 6 moderated usability sessions with platform admins (target: 3 enterprise, 3 startup).
Iterate on diff visual language (compact table vs. natural-language summary) and choose default.
Design member simulator: selection UX, attribute overlay, edge cases for external groups (SCIM/SSO).
Design temporal assignment timeline and expiry microcopy.
Produce final Figma files and generate dev tokens + CSS spec.
Prepare security checklist and submit for security review (see QA steps).
Create acceptance test plan for QA and link to e2e ticket for ENG rollout.
comments: 2026-02-10 Avery Chen: Kickoff — scoped to role editor + member assignment flows. Prioritizing preview-before-commit to reduce incidents resembling recent privilege regression P0s.

2026-02-12 Maya Ruiz: Initial sketches uploaded to Figma. Two approaches: side-by-side diff table vs. inline natural language summary. Asking ENG for performance constraints for live simulation queries.

2026-02-13 Sanjay Patel (Eng): Live simulation should be best-effort—avoid blocking save. Suggest background evaluation job that fetches effective perms for sampled members. See ENG constraints: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4123.
2026-02-14 Usability session #1 notes: admins appreciated the timeline for expiring grants but found the diff table noisy. Action: add a compact summary line and a ‘show details’ toggle.

2026-02-16 PM review (Lina Morales): Request to surface SSO attribute source next to simulated member (e.g., 'dept=engineering from Okta'). Add requirement for a small help tooltip linking to SSO mapping docs.

2026-02-17 Security review kickoff: security wants explicit audit-log preview and a checkbox 'log this change to external SIEM' for enterprise installs. Filing follow-up with infra for audit log IDs (ENG-82012).

2026-02-18 Design update: high-fidelity v1 uploaded. Handoff checklist created and PR opened for prototype: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4123. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/rbac-commit-safe-v1
review_feedback: PM: Prefer natural-language change summary as default, with option to expand to a table for auditors.
Eng: Member simulation should run with a 2s timeout and degrade gracefully to 'approximate impact' with a cached sample.
Security: Must include an immutable audit payload including change author, timestamp, pre/post hashes, and SSO attribute snapshot.
Design: Improve contrast and provide iconography for 'add', 'remove', and 'modify' states; ensure colorblind-safe palette.
decisions: Use two-tier diff UI: top-line natural language summary + expandable detailed table for auditors.
Member simulator will be best-effort: first tries live evaluation for selected members, falls back to cached sample if the live call times out.
Temporal grants appear inline on the role page and in the member list with an expiry pill and calendar integration for admins.
Audit entries will link to Console audit viewer and include a stable change-hash for cross-referencing with Dedicated/Private deployments.
